compose.attachmentsLost: This draft is no longer in Drafts, and its attachments went with it. Your text is still here.
compose.changedElsewhere: This draft changed elsewhere. Your text is saved over that version: press Send again to send it.
compose.notFiled: It could not be filed in Sent.
compose.noteDraftNotRemoved: The draft could not be removed from Drafts.
compose.noteDraftKept: The draft was kept as the only copy of the message.
compose.noteOriginalNotMarked: The original could not be marked as answered.
compose.notSent: Not sent. The message stayed in Drafts.
compose.alreadySent: This message was already sent, and this draft is what was left of it, so it can't go out. Delete the draft, or write a new message.
compose.unknown: Can't confirm delivery. The message stayed in Drafts.
compose.sendAnywayQuestion: If the first attempt did get through, the message will arrive twice. Send it anyway?
compose.unsavedQuestion: The latest changes could not be saved. If you close now, they are lost; the last saved version stays in Drafts.
